**Welcome!** This is the hands-on companion to the Climate Data Cube session at the
[IEEE GRSS Autumn School 2026](https://it-u.at/en/events/earth-observation-and-geoai-for-climate-resilient-urban-systems-grss-school/).
You will download one month of a satellite climate product, crop it to a region, and turn it into a
compressed, chunked **Zarr v3 cube** that opens in a second and plots in a few lines of Python.

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-align: center
flowchart LR
  A["☁️ LSA SAF<br/>Data Service"] -->|"01_download_sample.sh"| B[("data/raw<br/>NetCDF disk")]
  B -->|"02_preprocess_cdo.sh<br/>crop · remap · QA"| C[("data/interim<br/>regional NetCDF")]
  C -->|"03_build_zarr_cube.py<br/>chunk · shard · compress"| D[("data/zarr<br/>cube.zarr")]
  D -->|"notebooks + plot_utils"| E["🗺️ maps<br/>📈 time series"]
  classDef s fill:#0e66a9,stroke:#3ddbd9,color:#fff
  classDef d fill:#ffb454,stroke:#d9780f,color:#10253a
  class A,E s
  class B,C,D d
```

## Already set up? The whole pipeline in five commands

::: {.terminal}
```bash
# 1. repository root (inside the Ubuntu / WSL window on Windows)
cd ~/projects/tutorial-repo
# 2. one month of raw NetCDF
bash code/01_download_sample.sh 2015 06 METREF
# 3. crop + remap to the AOI
MAIN_VARIABLE=METREF uv run bash code/02_preprocess_cdo.sh 0.05 data/raw/METREF data/interim/METREF
# 4. build the Zarr v3 cube
uv run python code/03_build_zarr_cube.py --input data/interim/METREF
# 5. explore (or open code/notebooks in VS Code)
uv run --extra notebook jupyter lab code/notebooks
```
:::

Not sure about a flag? The [**command builder**](tutorial/reference.qmd) generates these commands
for your product, month, AOI and machine.
